name: novel-director
description: 小说导演台：一句话题材一键推演成书。题材构思、世界与角色、章纲、角色并行推演、正文、连贯性与去 AI 味优化、定稿，一条流水线跑完；每一步落文件，可停、可改、可分支。

description_i18n.en: Novel Director: a one-command, simulation-first novel pipeline. Concept, world, cast, outline, multi-agent scene simulation, prose, continuity and de-AI revision, final manuscript. Every stage is file-backed, resumable and branchable.
